title: Krrsantan's Assassination Attempt
description: Boba Fett's bacta session is interrupted by an attack from Krrsantan. The fearsome Wookiee rips Fett from his pod, and the two battle until Krrsantan has the upper hand. Before he can finish off Fett, Drash comes in, plunging her dagger into the fearsome beast. Not far behind are the rest of the gang and the Gamorreans. Together, they lead him down to the rancor pit, where Fennec Shand opens the trap door and imprisons the Wookiee.
